place: Shoolpaneshwar (Gora), Garudeshwar and the riverbank shrines

timing.recurrence: The Hindu month of Shravan each year — roughly late July to late August, with Mondays as peak days

description: Shravan turns the district's riverbank temples up several notches: Shoolpaneshwar Mahadev at Gora runs long darshan queues every Monday, Garudeshwar's rhythm intensifies, and Narmada parikrama pilgrims thread through with their bundles. For devotees it is the month to come; for everyone else it is worth knowing that the quiet river temples of winter are, in these weeks, humming devotional fairs — with the monsoon river running high and brown behind them.
crowd_impact: Shravan Mondays bring queues and parking pressure at Gora and Garudeshwar; weekdays stay manageable.
tips: Non-devotee visitors: pick any day except Monday
Combine with Zarwani — the sanctuary is at full monsoon green
River bathing only at designated ghat steps; the Shravan river is powerful
